purpose: Executable baseline for Forge Pipeline path guarantees (measured, not aspirational).

state.description: StateManager accepts the canonical Forge transition chain idle→complete
Invalid idle→executing transition is rejected without mutating state
Transitions without a reason are rejected
Pipeline can enter blocked state from executing (failure path)
Pipeline can replan via blocked→decomposing (recovery path)

tool.description: Forge worker tool catalog exposes core execution tools
Unknown tool names return an error result instead of silent success
before_tool_call hook can block a tool invocation

verification.description: parseBuildOutput marks clean build output as success
parseBuildOutput extracts file:line errors from TypeScript output
parseTestOutput counts pass/fail from node:test output
detectRegressions flags newly failing tests against prior run

reviewer.description: quickReviewCheck accepts a complete worker protocol aligned with vision
quickReviewCheck rejects FORBIDDEN-list violations in worker output
Empty reviewer LLM response is classified insufficient (no auto-PASS leniency)
parseReviewResponse maps REJECT verdict to NO-GO with rejection feedback
parseReviewResponse maps NEEDS_REVISION to NO-GO with actionable feedback

rollback.description: RollbackEngine.createPoint returns null when project is not a git repo
Orchestrator.run invokes rollback.createPoint at pipeline start
Rollback to unknown point returns success=false without throwing
rollbackLastAtom returns null when insufficient atom checkpoints exist

resume.description: PipelineResumeEngine persists and reloads checkpoint data
run({resume:true}) without checkpoint continues as fresh run (warning only)
Corrupt checkpoint JSON returns null on load (recovery without crash)
